newsitem.title: CHINA: China trade surplus $13.92 bln in January-May.
newsitem.headline: China trade surplus $13.92 bln in January-May.

text.p: China posted a trade surplus of $13.92 billion for the first five months of this year compared with a deficit of $451 million for the same period of last year, state television said on Friday quoting customs statistics.
Note: Figures in billions of U.S. dollars.
Exports soared by 26.4 percent compared with last year, while imports decreased by 1.2 percent, the figures showed.
Over the five months, the monthly increase rates for exports exceeded 20 percent, the customs said.
Exports of state-owned enterprises rose by 25 percent over last year and accounted for 56 percent of the total.
Exports by overseas-funded firms rose by 26.5 percent and accounted for 41 percent of the total.
